newsitem.title: JAPAN: Tokyo Nikkei closes up, export-oriented firms lead.
newsitem.headline: Tokyo Nikkei closes up, export-oriented firms lead.

text.p: Tokyo stocks closed firmer on Tuesday, lifted by buying of export-related shares that benefit from a weaker yen, brokers said. They added that it was easier to buy today because it was the first day of trade for November delivery, but turnover remained modest.
The benchmark Nikkei 225 settled at 20,958.08, up 72.67 points or 0.35 percent. Its December futures however ended 30 points lower at 20,940.
"The market rebounded after losses piled up last week," Kenzo Doi, a strategist at Kokusai Securities, said. "But the Nikkei average is still basically stuck in a box range."
